title: Donna C NDE 9893
content: I experienced an imprint of what was a body of light above my body. Suddenly, my horizontally floating body morphed into what was an orb of white light that floated out of the house. Once in the sky, I took off upwards and gradually turned into a tiny seed of light. Then, I was at a multi-dimensional void that was turning in two directions. I was on the current that was spinning out of the void. I was a tiny light with uncountable other lights. All vibrated with infinite octaves of Aum. I was blissful beyond description. When I got onto the swirl going inwards, I was stopped. Telepathically, I was told that if I continued on that the connection to my body would be destroyed. I said that my body was sick. They replied that we will heal it. I said, 'It's tough down there.' They said,'You are almost old enough to be on your own. Do you want to go through childhood again? For you have karma.' I immediately saw a life review in a split second and didn't want that life again. I asked, 'Will you be there to help me if I need you down there?' They told me, 'Yes, but to not over-ask.' So, I asked if I could bliss out again. They said, 'Yes, but when your mind started up again, we will go back.' I returned in reverse only with invisible helpers. Meaning, that I was a seed of light, then an orb, then a full light body, then entry into body. They got me on my feet and spun me in one direction then the other. I woke up on the floor, fully covered in oily sweat. I was tired, but awake and alive. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1971 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness Life threatening event, but not clinical death. I had viral and bacterial infections not responding to medications. Received blessings with Lourdes water as my spleen was ready to totally malfunction. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than norma. I was one with universal bliss, peace, joy and fully my own mind but freed from normal human variables of mood. It was like getting soul downloads. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? The entire time Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. Time was irrelevant. It seemed to me that I traveled beyond the speed of light. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I had many lucid dreams prior to this event. In one I was swallowed I to the ocean and I screamed for the world to stop. I was lifted out of the ocean onto land. Then the event took place in my room. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Heard with telepathy. Sound was far richer. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Uncertain Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm All vibration and light and pure sound. Amazing vortex. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Bliss, joy, love. Immediate light speed thought. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others. I understood concepts like karma and reincarnation and acted with that knowledge when I had to choose to stay or go. It was my choice they made that clear. Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life They made it clear if I stayed I would have to reincarnate. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic I also practice Eastern Style Meditation as well as prayer. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I believed in God anyway but this experience was beyond an anthropological depiction of God as a andromorphic deity. It was all vibration, sound, then light. Light seemed to be most gross element in this cosmic space. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Returned full of heightened empathy and have ESP Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin The voice had pronouns of we. I heard it telepathically. It was a presence. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes Again I'd have another life eventually if I stayed. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes I had no doubt that consciousness is vast beyond my limited ability to contain it During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes There was clear recognition that I was a soul and this was a place inside a realm and I was at a portal of that place beyond. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Uncertain I've been very psychic since that event. Many gifts given to me spiritually. I spent my career helping clients overcome stress. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes I asked what my karma was and was told I didn't need to know it that I just had to believe it was important to face it by going back either then or later in another life. During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes This was a gateway of life and death of my body and the soul's ability to still connect. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes It was all encompassing love. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? I empathize easily. I often see auras around people. Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Words are not up to the task of describing this event. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes clairvoyance and pre-cognitive knowledge of events. Down loads in dreams. Lots of synchronization and paranormal events. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes It took a long time Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes Meditation m07ecfw_nde

arrival.other_being_detail: Telepathic "we" presence; she also described "invisible helpers" during return.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Returned "in reverse" as seed of light → orb → full light body → entry into body; helpers got her on her feet and spun her.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/light-body transformation and ascent → multi-dimensional void/vortex with many lights and Aum vibration → verbal boundary warning about severing body connection → brief life review flash → choice/negotiation to return → reverse-sequence return into body with helpers.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Described morphing from floating body into an orb of white light, then into a tiny "seed of light"; multi-dimensional void turning in two directions with inward/outward swirls; uncountable lights vibrating with "infinite octaves of Aum"; return assisted by "invisible helpers" who spun her on her feet.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "All vibrated with infinite octaves of Aum."; "I was blissful beyond description."; "if I continued on that the connection to my body would be destroyed."; "You are almost old enough to be on your own. Do you want to go through childhood again? For you have karma."; "Yes, but to not over-ask."
